text:
nina (product): hey @people-ops — quick urgent one. I got the yellow fever vaccine yesterday for a work trip to Brazil. Clinic billed $150, my EOB says denied as "preventive/excluded". I'm on the Global plan. Claim# 55566777, service date 2026-03-18, member id ends 2290. Anyone seen this?

alexa (People Ops): oh no. can you DM a photo of the EOB + itemized receipt? Also does the claim show CPT 90655 or 90715? some carrier mappings vary.

nina (product): EOB shows code 90715 and reason "not covered - travel vaccine". Provider NPI 1122334455. I'll DM the pics.

tom (Benefits): okay — two things to know: some carriers treat travel-only immunizations as elective and exclude them unless they're medically necessary or employer-required for business travel. Our Global plan does include a rider for "employer-required travel immunizations" but it requires preauthorization or a company travel authorization form submitted with the claim.

nina (product): ugh, we didn't do preauth. this trip was confirmed late. is there a retroactive path?

tom (Benefits): we can try two paths: 1) Ask the carrier to reopen/retroactively authorize if we submit a business travel authorization + manager attestation that the vaccine was required for the trip. 2) File an internal appeal once carrier denies (we'll attach employer letter and itinerary). Both need docs. If you want us to act, please upload: itinerary, manager email confirming requirement, itemized receipt, EOB.

alexa (People Ops): @nina I can draft the company attestation for you if you paste your manager's name and destination + dates. We normally ask managers to confirm in an email and sign the travel immunization form. Quick template we use: ```Employee: NINA (redwood)
Purpose: Business travel to BRAZIL (Sao Paulo)
Trip dates: 2026-03-22 to 2026-03-30
Immunization required: Yellow Fever (90715)
Business justification: On-site customer deployment with country entry requirement
Manager: OLIVER (mgr) — email: oliver@redwood.com
Authorized by: People Ops on behalf of Company"```

alexa (People Ops): once you DM the EOB i'll generate the attestation and get manager to sign.

claims-bot: Carrier case opened: REF-TRV-2026-889. Carrier SLA: up to 10 business days for initial review. We'll request retroactive authorization and reprocessing.

tom (Benefits): if carrier refuses retro auth, we'll file an appeal citing employer requirement + attach itinerary and manager attestation. Appeals typically take longer (up to 30 days) but we've had success when employer-required proof is clear.

hr-bot: Travel immunization policy & upload portal: https://benefits.example.com/travel-vax — upload EOB + manager confirmation and select "retro auth request".

nina (product): thanks all — DMing receipts and manager confirmation now. manager okayed signing. appreciate the quick help :relieved:

alexa (People Ops): got the DM. drafting the attestation and will email manager for signature. I'll cc you once filed with carrier. :white_check_mark:
